02 / ABOUT THE DEVELOPER

Behind the code,
a drive to build.

I’m John Clarence Layog, focused on programming and software development. I build websites, web applications, and useful software tools, with attention to both functionality and the experience of using them.

My current working project is Centrix Labs, a platform for uploading and releasing free apps. I’m continuing its development, including payment integration and additional features.
